answer: An agent network can require each identity to lock a scarce token stake before it may submit jobs, then slash that stake when independently verified work is fraudulent or repeatedly invalid. Sybils do not gain influence merely by multiplying accounts: each one needs its own locked capital, and detected abuse destroys part of it. For example, zephyr, zenith, and willow can each register, but faking three reputations means funding three stakes and risking all three. The cost is capital tied up in advance, plus losses when caught.
